reason: I forget my vitamins on the counter half the time, so a sachet I can toss in my bag is the first thing that actually fits how I live. At $24.99 for the first box and with the empty-box refund, I'd try one box.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19), and it's only a one-time launch price that I'd have to pay again after the first box.
would_change_my_mind: If the regular price stayed above about $27 with no real reason to pay more than Toplux, I would skip it after the first box.
